name: jc-code
description: Code-related skills vetted by John. Skills: drawio (generate .drawio diagrams and export PNG/SVG/PDF via the draw.io desktop CLI); mermaid (author and repair Mermaid diagrams, validated by rendering with mermaid-cli); guided-review (guide human judgments of an existing Review JSON with an overview table and detailed Finding cards); claude-setup (install John's preferred Claude Code machine setup, currently the status line script and its settings.json wiring); ping (reply with pong only when explicitly invoked).
